title: Merchants seed
description: The seed of merchants a deployment may import at start-up (ADR-031): the file named by OPE_MERCHANTS_FILE (this object) or the JSON of OPE_MERCHANTS (this object, or the bare array of merchants). Imported by the `system` operator only when the merchant store starts empty; never overrides what an operator registered. Shape only: the rules are the Merchant's, the Experiment's and the declared configuration's (a rejected value stops the start naming the field).

$schema.description: Path of this schema, for the editor.

merchantId.description: Identifier of the merchant, as the credentials and the administration API name it.

ingestKeys.description: Raw values of the ingest credentials (`X-OPE-Ingest-Key`); the import stores their fingerprints, never the values. One or two.

platformKeys.description: Raw values of the platform credentials (`X-OPE-Platform-Key`, server to server; ADR-025). At most two.

platformSecrets.description: Secrets of the platform signature (ADR-029); with at least one, every platform request must be signed. At most two.

origins.description: Origins the SDK may call from: `scheme://host[:port]`, no path. At least one.

experiments.description: Experiments opened at start-up with the store empty (ADR-022); the holdout does not judge the seed. At most one open (calibrating or active) per merchant.

experimentId.description: Identifier of the experiment (the API mints `exp_` + base32; the seed may choose its own).

treatmentShare.description: Share of the visitors assigned to treatment, as a fraction of 1; the split resolves to whole buckets of one hundredth.

seed.description: Seed of the assignment hash: the same visitor lands in the same arm for the life of the experiment.

targetSample.description: Visitors the experiment aims to observe.

cuts.description: Interim analyses as increasing fractions of the target sample.

status.description: State at start-up: `calibrating` assigns and decides without counting; `active` starts the window at `openedAt`; `closed` is terminal.

openedAt.description: Instant the experiment opened (RFC 3339); an active one starts its window here.
